title: Adding numbers 1-10 | Learn Addition to 10 for Kids

summary: A 2-hour Numberblocks compilation teaching kids to count from 1 to 100. Watch numbers grow, patterns emerge, and counting becomes an exciting journey for Grade 1 learners.

subject: Mathematics
summary: Kids Academy teaches basic addition and subtraction up to 20 with colorful visuals and engaging examples. Perfect for Grade 1 students building number fluency.

subject: English
summary: Khan Academy Kids introduces the letter A with Ollo the elephant. Learn the letter sound, see example words, and practice recognition in this research-backed early literacy video.

subject: English
summary: Join Elmo and friends as they sing through numbers 1 to 20 and all letters of the alphabet. A comprehensive review compilation perfect for Grade 1 literacy reinforcement.

title: Addition 1 to 9 with Dino - Math for Kindergarten & 1st Grade
subject: Mathematics
summary: Dino the friendly dinosaur teaches simple addition up to 10 by counting apples, butterflies, and more. Colorful visuals make math fun for Grade 1 learners.

title: The Mess That We Made read by Kathryn Hahn | Storyline Online
subject: English
summary: Kathryn Hahn reads 'The Mess That We Made,' a cumulative tale about the impact of trash on the ocean. Teaches environmental responsibility while building reading comprehension.

title: Minions | A Cosmic Kids Yoga Adventure!
subject: Physical Education

subject: Mathematics
summary: Learn subtraction as taking away with this engaging song. Understand that subtraction means removing objects from a group and finding how many are left.

title: The Measuring Song | Length, Weight, Capacity
